embeds.title: BLHA DEADLINE DAY TRADE CENTER: TRADE BAIT
embeds.description: The deadline-day trade bait board. One reply per franchise: what you're moving and what you need.

fields.name: HOW TO POST
fields.value: Reply once for your franchise and edit that reply as things change, so the thread stays one post per team. Delete it once you're done dealing.

fields.name: FORMAT
fields.value:
**Available:** players and picks you'd move
**Looking for:** positions, prospects or picks
**Reach me:** DM, or reply in **💬│trade-discussion**

fields.name: DEADLINE
fields.value: **`[TIMESTAMP]`** • 11:59 PM ET, end of Week 20. A trade must be fully processed in Fantrax before the deadline; one processed after it is reversed (11.6).

fields.name: ALLOWED IN TRADES
fields.value: Rostered players, eligible draft picks and current-season FAAB. Cash, loans, rentals, predetermined tradebacks and conditional picks are prohibited (Article XI). A future 1st- or 2nd-round pick needs the seller's prepayment confirmed in **💰│league-ledger** first (Article XII).

fields.name: FOLLOW ALONG
fields.value: From 9:00 AM ET the live tracker in **📢│announcements** counts down and lists every trade. Each trade also gets a report card and a just-for-fun poll in **💬│trade-discussion**.
